move: prompt types out, generate press, noise diffuses into an image
how: A dark app frame with a prompt field, option chips, a gradient button, and an output pane holding a canvas, a step counter, a progress bar and a done badge. The caret blinks (steps(1) yoyo) while TextPlugin types the prompt over 26% of the clip; a chip toggles on; at 41% the button presses scale 0.96 and rebounds with elastic.out(1,0.4) with a white flash, and the label changes. From 44% a state object tweens p 0 to 1 over 3.4s (power2.inOut) with an onUpdate that redraws the canvas: a procedural sunset scene drawn pixelated (block size 48 to 1) and blurred (14px to 0) with a fading seeded noise overlay, while the progress bar fills, the step counter counts to 30 and the grid fades. At 79% the done badge pops with back.out(2) and the canvas zooms 1.06; at 95% the output pane fades, the prompt clears and the placeholder returns. Timeline is 10s.
adapt: Change the prompt string, app name, chips, step count and the procedural scene (or draw a supplied image into the offscreen canvas); keep the 2.6s type, 3.4s power2.inOut resolve and the button press.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the UI and the offscreen scene canvas; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline; the canvas is already driven by an onUpdate tween on a state object, so it ports directly with draw() closed over el. Scope selectors to el.
caveats: the output pane is faded to opacity 0 at the end but never restored, so the loop does not return to the empty-state first frame
per-frame pixel noise loop (fillRect per 4px cell) and canvas filter blur are slow
